arcanes.name: Melee Afflictions
arcanes.text: Enemies affected by Status Effects gain 6 additional stacks when they're knocked down or flung by melee attacks.

arcanes.name: Melee Animosity
arcanes.text: On Melee Hit: Gain 42% Critical Chance on your next Heavy Attack, up to 420%

arcanes.name: Melee Assimilation
arcanes.text: On Shield Break: +150% Melee Damage on Heavy Attack and Heavy Attack kills restore +30% of max Shields for 20s.

arcanes.name: Melee Careen
arcanes.text: x2.50 Melee Damage against Frozen enemies. On Roll: Freeze enemies in a 5.5m radius with a 2s Cooldown.

arcanes.name: Melee Crescendo
arcanes.text: On Finisher Kill: Gain 6 Initial Combo for the rest of your mission

arcanes.name: Melee Doughty
arcanes.text: Gain 1.0x Critical Damage for every 10% Puncture Status chance on your Melee Weapon.

arcanes.name: Melee Duplicate
arcanes.text: On Base Critical Hits: 100% chance for your attack to strike a second time

arcanes.name: Melee Exposure
arcanes.text: On Ability Cast: Gain 60% Corrosive Damage on Melee strikes for 25s. Stacks up to 240%.

arcanes.name: Melee Fortification
arcanes.text: On Melee Kill: +210 Armor for 10s

arcanes.name: Melee Influence
arcanes.text: On Melee Electricity Status: 20% chance for elemental Melee Status Effects to apply to enemies within 20m for 18s. Cannot refresh while active.

arcanes.name: Melee Retaliation
arcanes.text: Gain 30% Melee Damage for every 200 current Shields, up to 420%. Bonus halved for Overshields.

arcanes.name: Melee Vortex
arcanes.text: Kill an enemy affected by Magnetic Status for a 45% chance to pull in enemies within 18m radius

arcanes.name: Fractalized Reset
arcanes.text: On Ability Cast: +240% Reload Speed for 5s

arcanes.name: Longbow Sharpshot
arcanes.text: On Weak Point Hit: Gain +300% damage on your next shot.

arcanes.name: Primary Blight
arcanes.text: On Toxin Status Effect: +3.6% Critical Damage and +1.8% Multishot for 12s. Stacks up to 40x.

arcanes.name: Primary Bulwark
arcanes.text: Gain +1% damage for each unit of armor past 1,000, up to a max of +500%.

arcanes.name: Primary Compression
arcanes.text: On aim: x0.2 explosion radius, +100% damage and +5.5% ammo efficiency for every 1m radius lost.

arcanes.name: Primary Crux
arcanes.text: On Weak Point Hit: Gain +30% Status Chance and +6% Ammo Efficiency for 10s. Stacks up to 10x.

arcanes.name: Primary Deadhead
arcanes.text: On Weak Point Kill: +120% Damage for 24s. Stacks up to 3x. +30% to Headshot Multiplier -50% Weapon Recoil / +30% to Headshot Multiplier / -50% Weapon Recoil

arcanes.name: Primary Debilitate
arcanes.text: If an enemy has 10 stacks of a combined Status Effect, inflicting the same Status Effect again has a 100% chance to inflict one of the base Status Effects it is composed of.

arcanes.name: Primary Dexterity
arcanes.text: On Melee Kill: +60% Damage for 20s. Stacks up to 6x. +7.5s Combo Duration / +7.5s Combo Duration

arcanes.name: Primary Exhilarate
arcanes.text: On Weapon Impact Status Effect: +1.2 Energy Regen/s for 10s. Stacks up to 3x.

arcanes.name: Primary Frostbite
arcanes.text: On Cold Status Effect: +3% Critical Damage and +2.25% Multishot for 12s. Stacks up to 40x.

arcanes.name: Primary Merciless
arcanes.text: On Kill: +30% Damage for 4s. Stacks up to 12x. +30% Reload Speed / +30% Reload Speed

arcanes.name: Primary Obstruct
arcanes.text: On Weapon Magnetic Status Effect: Enemy weapons jam within 15m of target. Cooldown 10s.

arcanes.name: Primary Overcharge
arcanes.text: While at or above 90% Energy: Gain 35% of Max Energy as Multishot, capped at 350%.

arcanes.name: Primary Plated Round
arcanes.text: On Reload: Deal increased damage per round loaded based on max magazine size. Lasts for 10s.

arcanes.name: Akimbo Slip Shot
arcanes.text: While sliding or aim gliding: Gain 65% ammo efficiency with Dual Pistols.

arcanes.name: Cascadia Accuracy
arcanes.text: On Roll: +300% Critical Chance on Weak Point Hits for 4s

arcanes.name: Cascadia Empowered
arcanes.text: On Status Effect: Deals +750 Damage matching the Damage Type of the Status Effect

arcanes.name: Cascadia Flare
arcanes.text: On Heat Status Effect: +12% Damage for 10s. Stacks up to 480%.

arcanes.name: Cascadia Overcharge
arcanes.text: While Overshields Active: +300% Critical Chance

arcanes.name: Conjunction Voltage
arcanes.text: On Electricity Status Effect: +1.5% Reload Speed and +3% Multishot for 12s. Stacks up to 40x.

arcanes.name: Secondary Cryogenic
arcanes.text: On Puncture: Apply 3 Cold stacks on targets within 15m.

arcanes.name: Secondary Deadhead
arcanes.text: On Weak Point Kill: +120% Damage for 24s. Stacks up to 3x. +30% to Headshot Multiplier -50% Weapon Recoil / +30% to Headshot Multiplier / -50% Weapon Recoil

arcanes.name: Secondary Dexterity
arcanes.text: On Melee Kill: +60% Damage for 20s. Stacks up to 6x. +7.5s Combo Duration / +7.5s Combo Duration

arcanes.name: Secondary Encumber
arcanes.text: On Status Effect: +24% chance to trigger a second random Status Effect.

arcanes.name: Secondary Enervate
arcanes.text: On Hit: Increase Critical Chance by 10%. Resets after 6 Big Critical Hit.

arcanes.name: Secondary Fortifier
arcanes.text: Gain 1 Overguard for every 100 Damage dealt to an enemy's Overguard. Deals x8 Extra Damage to Overguard. / Deals x8 Extra Damage to Overguard.

arcanes.name: Secondary Irradiate
arcanes.text: On hitting enemies afflicted by 10 stacks of Radiation: Deal 180% of the hit damage to enemies within 7m.

arcanes.name: Secondary Kinship
arcanes.text: While Buffing Ally Warframes: +20% Critical Chance per buff

arcanes.name: Secondary Merciless
arcanes.text: On Kill: +30% Damage for 4s. Stacks up to 12x. +30% Reload Speed / +30% Reload Speed

arcanes.name: Secondary Outburst
arcanes.text: On swapping to Secondary Weapon, consume all Combo Multipliers to increase Secondary Weapon Critical Chance and Critical Damage by 20% per Combo consumed for 30s.

arcanes.name: Secondary Shiver
arcanes.text: Enemies take +45% damage per Cold Status

arcanes.name: Secondary Surge
arcanes.text: On Ability Cast: Next shot gains a Damage Multiplier for every 200 current Energy, up to x8.

arcanes.name: Shotgun Vendetta
arcanes.text: On shotgun kill within 5m of target: +180% Multishot and +75% Reload Speed for 15s.
